title: G2 Winter Report: Zuddl wins 35+ awards including 'Leader', 'Best Relationship, and 'Easiest Setup'
summary: Zuddl has earned recognition with over 35 awards in various markets and categories, including awards for relationship management, ease of setup, and for our exceptional customer service.
body_markdown:
The unified events and webinar platform bagged awards across multiple markets and in different categories including Virtual Event Platforms, Webinars & Event Management Platforms, to name a few.
